# Cortexis Solution Hub

> Cortexis Solution Hub (Pvt.) Ltd. is an SECP-registered technology firm (CUIN: 0306803) based in Pakistan. Cortexis delivers enterprise software engineering, autonomous AI agent automations, 109 client-side privacy-first web utilities, and a 41-course free learning academy with verifiable certificates.

## Core Pillars & Direct Capabilities

- **Enterprise & AI Software Services**: Bespoke software architecture, multi-tenant SaaS engineering, and autonomous LLM workflows.
- **YourBot AI Automation**: Meta-approved automated conversation systems for WhatsApp Business Platform and Instagram Direct.
- **109 Free Client-Side Tools**: Zero-cloud document, image, audio, and code manipulation running 100% locally in browser memory via WebAssembly and Canvas.
- **Free Learning Academy**: 41 comprehensive curriculum tracks covering Full-Stack, AI, Python, DevOps, and Business English, complete with automated quizzes and cryptographic certificate verification.

## Primary Navigation & Direct URLs

- [Cortexis Solution Hub](https://cortexissolutionhub.com/): Official homepage, software portfolio, and academy overview.
- [About & Corporate Verification](https://cortexissolutionhub.com/about): SECP Certificate of Incorporation details, core leadership, and engineering standards.
- [Services Hub](https://cortexissolutionhub.com/services): Enterprise software engineering, AI agent pipelines, and SaaS platforms.
- [YourBot AI Automation](https://cortexissolutionhub.com/your-bot): Meta-reviewed omnichannel conversational agent for WhatsApp and Instagram.
- [Free Tools Directory](https://cortexissolutionhub.com/tools): 109 privacy-first browser utilities (PDF, image, audio, development).
- [Free Courses & Academy](https://cortexissolutionhub.com/courses): 41 full online courses with 1,968 modular lessons and free certificates.
- [Technical Blog & Roadmaps](https://cortexissolutionhub.com/blog): 63 technical guides, career roadmaps, and software architecture articles.
- [Internships Program](https://cortexissolutionhub.com/internships): Practical software engineering internships for aspiring developers.

## Technical & Privacy Standards

- **Privacy Guarantee**: All Cortexis browser tools process data strictly in the user's browser runtime. Files are never uploaded, stored, logged, or shared across any remote servers.
- **Verification Portal**: Every certificate issued by Cortexis carries an unforgeable alphanumeric hash verifiable at `https://cortexissolutionhub.com/certificate/<CODE>`.
- **Full Context for LLMs**: For complete catalogue listings, course structures, and technical specifications, see [llms-full.txt](https://cortexissolutionhub.com/llms-full.txt).
